purpose: Hot state for recurring XerahS hourly review selection. Keep this file small and machine-readable; archive raw detail separately.
selection_rules: Read this JSON first, then the short current tracker only if human context is needed.
Prefer the stalest high-priority area that is not blocked by a larger prerequisite.
After a run, update the matching area, prepend one compact last_runs item, and archive detailed evidence by log path only.
Do not paste full build/test output into hot state or the current tracker.

last_runs.topic: Encrypted S3 mobile destination config export
last_runs.outcome: Amazon S3 .xsdc export now fails fast when BucketName is blank, preventing mobile import from saving an unusable S3 destination; full Release validation passed.
Linux X11 hotkey dispatch now requires an exact non-lock modifier match, preventing Ctrl+Shift shortcuts from firing when Alt/Super is also held; full Release validation passed.
History file-path lookups now compare case-insensitively on macOS as well as Windows; targeted and full Release validation passed.

Bounded random thumbnail seeks to the current thumbnail index segment, avoiding duplicate/out-of-range random slots on the shared RandomFast path; added regression coverage; bumped version to 0.22.154.

Reject duplicate normalized package entry paths during safe extraction so validated manifests/assemblies cannot be overwritten by later zip entries; added regression coverage; bumped version to 0.22.153.
Direct window closes now complete editor sessions with null, preserving task-mode cancel/no-save handling; added regression coverage; bumped version to 0.22.152.

last_runs.topic: NUnit test discovery package asset metadata
last_runs.outcome: Added PrivateAssets/all and explicit IncludeAssets for Microsoft.NET.Test.Sdk and NUnit3TestAdapter in XerahS.Tests; added regression guard; bumped version to 0.22.151.
SaveUploadersConfig now raises SettingsChanged like application/workflow saves; version bumped to 0.22.150.
Unsubscribed removed onboarding OCR language options during platform language refresh and added regression coverage.
Preserved fractional capture bounds outward and avoided invalid/overflow-prone casts before clamping.
Allowed weekly-only backup zip creation and added focused coverage.
Started fade immediately for valid zero-duration auto-hide toasts and added focused coverage.

last_runs.outcome: Created missing retry directories from the parent remote path instead of bare filenames.
